cond_0001.intro: The Quality Engineer will oversee quality-related endeavors encompassing both new product development and continuous improvement efforts. They will lead various activities such as product qualification testing, customer complaint analysis, and internal audits. Additionally, they will develop and sustain technical quality plans, review design drawings, and implement problem-solving techniques to ensure product excellence. The ideal candidate will possess organizational skills, effective communication abilities, and a commitment to maintaining high-quality standards throughout the manufacturing process.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Lead quality-related activities for both new product development and continuous improvement efforts.
Coordinate product qualification testing, customer complaint analysis, and quality management system activities.
Develop and sustain technical quality plans, review drawings, and implement problem-solving techniques.
Analyze data to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements and establish quality metrics.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in a scientific/engineering field with a minimum of 2 years' experience in manufacturing/quality/engineering.
Proficiency in ISO 9001 requirements and the ability to interpret design drawings and schematics.
Communication skills for internal and external issue resolution and formal presentations.
Experience in solving complex non-conformances through the CAPA process.
Organizational skills with the ability to initiate and complete tasks in a timely manner.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of LEAN, Six Sigma, SPC methodologies, FMEA, military standards, and SAP functions.
Previous experience in high-volume product manufacturing.

cond_0060.intro: The Quality Engineer will oversee quality-related work across new product development and continuous improvement. This role involves regular contact with internal teams and customers — leading qualification testing, analyzing complaints, and running audits. You'll develop and maintain technical quality plans, review design drawings, and apply problem-solving techniques to keep product quality on track. Strong communication and organizational skills are important, as is a commitment to quality standards throughout the manufacturing process.
cond_0060.responsibilities:
Lead quality-related activities for both new product development and continuous improvement efforts.
Coordinate product qualification testing, customer complaint analysis, and quality management system activities — staying in regular contact with internal and external stakeholders throughout.
Develop and sustain technical quality plans, review drawings, and implement problem-solving techniques.
Analyze data to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements and establish quality metrics.
Communicate findings and quality issues clearly, walking teams through root causes and corrective actions.

Organizational skills with the ability to initiate and complete tasks on time

Additionally, they will develop and sustain technical quality plans, review design drawings, and implement problem-solving techniques to ensure product excellence. The ideal candidate will possess organizational skills, effective communication abilities, and a commitment to maintaining high-quality standards throughout the manufacturing process.
cond_0127.responsibilities:
Lead quality-related activities for both new product development and continuous improvement efforts.
Coordinate product qualification testing, customer complaint analysis, and quality management system activities.
Develop and sustain technical quality plans, review drawings, and implement problem-solving techniques.
Analyze data to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements and establish quality metrics.
cond_0127.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in a scientific/engineering field with a minimum of 2 years' experience in manufacturing/quality/engineering.
Proficiency in ISO 9001 requirements and the ability to interpret design drawings and schematics.
Communication skills for internal and external issue resolution and formal presentations.
Experience in solving complex non-conformances through the CAPA process.
Organizational skills with the ability to initiate and complete tasks in a timely manner.
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of LEAN, Six Sigma, SPC methodologies, FMEA, military standards, and SAP functions.
Previous experience in high-volume product manufacturing.

cond_0306.responsibilities:
Coordinate quality-related activities for both new product development and continuous improvement efforts.
Work with cross-functional teams on product qualification testing, customer complaint analysis, and quality management system activities.
Collaborate on developing and sustaining technical quality plans, review drawings, and support problem-solving efforts.
Share analysis of data to help ensure compliance with internal and external requirements and contribute to establishing quality metrics.
cond_0306.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in a scientific/engineering field with a minimum of 2 years' experience in manufacturing/quality/engineering.
Proficiency in ISO 9001 requirements and the ability to interpret design drawings and schematics.
Communication skills for internal and external issue resolution and formal presentations.
Experience in solving complex non-conformances through the CAPA process.
Organizational skills with the ability to initiate and complete tasks in a timely manner.
Knowledge of LEAN, Six Sigma, SPC methodologies, FMEA, military standards, and SAP functions.
Previous experience in high-volume product manufacturing.

Additionally, they will develop and sustain technical quality plans, review design drawings, and implement problem-solving techniques to ensure product excellence. The ideal candidate will possess organizational skills, effective communication abilities, and a commitment to maintaining high-quality standards throughout the manufacturing process.
cond_0390.responsibilities:
Lead quality-related activities for both new product development and continuous improvement efforts.
Coordinate product qualification testing, customer complaint analysis, and quality management system activities.
Develop and sustain technical quality plans, review drawings, and implement problem-solving techniques.
Analyze data to ensure compliance with internal and external requirements and establish quality metrics.
cond_0390.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a scientific/engineering field, or equivalent practical experience, with around 2–3 years of experience in manufacturing, quality, or engineering.
Familiarity with ISO 9001 requirements and the ability to interpret design drawings and schematics.
Ability to communicate effectively for internal and external issue resolution and formal presentations.
Experience working through non-conformances using the CAPA process; candidates still building this skill are welcome to apply.
Organizational skills with the ability to initiate and complete tasks in a timely manner.
Background in LEAN, Six Sigma, SPC methodologies, FMEA, military standards, and SAP functions.
Some experience in high-volume product manufacturing, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
cond_0390.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.
